content: {"action":"write_off","reasoning":"CO-97 identifies CPT 93271 as contractually bundled into another paid service, so it is not separately payable and cannot be shifted to the patient. Authorization was not required, retro-authorization is unavailable, and neither resubmission nor a medical-necessity appeal would correct the bundling determination. With peer-to-peer already attempted, the remaining balance should be closed as a contractual write-off."}
